description: Patient physiology and clinical timeseries: vitals, labs, interventions, outcomes. Decompensation precursors, treatment response, circadian rhythms.

characteristic_patterns.name: Circadian rhythm
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: FFT dominant period near 86400 s on vital

characteristic_patterns.name: Decompensation precursor
characteristic_patterns.signature: increasing HR + decreasing SpO₂ over hours, escalating EWS
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: joint trend rising HR + falling SpO₂ over ≥ 4h

characteristic_patterns.name: Treatment response
characteristic_patterns.signature: vital / lab moves toward target after intervention timestamp
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: ruptures change-point near intervention ts on relevant signal

characteristic_patterns.name: Deterioration trajectory
characteristic_patterns.signature: EWS climbing across multiple vital channels
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: ≥ 3 vitals breaching their soft constraints over a 6h window

action_library.label: Escalate surveillance
action_library.description: Move patient to higher-acuity monitoring when decompensation precursor confidence is high.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Earlier ICU transfer reduces mortality on surveyed cases (approx. 20% absolute risk reduction in some EWS literature).

action_library.label: Order differential workup
action_library.description: When abnormal vitals defy the active diagnosis, order targeted labs / imaging to widen differential.
triggered_when: abnormal reading not explained by current dx
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Workup resolves the question in ≈55% of ambiguous cases.

action_library.label: Review current treatment
action_library.description: When response to active intervention is below baseline expectation, escalate review.
triggered_when: treatment_response signature absent within expected window
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Reviews uncover causes (under-dose, wrong drug) ≈40% of the time.

action_library.label: Tighten alert threshold
action_library.description: Adapt the early-warning threshold for this patient based on personal baseline + circadian.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Personalised thresholds reduce alert fatigue and improve catch-rate.
